data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) were GBP 360.523m. During 2014 there was a net release of GBP 22.8m (a favourable development of approximately 6.3% of opening gross claims), described as a release in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end. The movement is principally attributed to favourable run-off in long-tail casualty classes. The report does not disclose a gross prior-year movement figure; the stated GBP 22.8m is a net (after-reinsurance) release and has been used as the best available quantified prior year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).

A positive run-off of GBP 10.0m on the 2012 and prior years' reserves (2011 and prior: GBP 17.2m) was experienced in the year. This change to the previous closed year reserves was 4.2% of the relevant provisions brought forward. The change in the year was principally due to the favourable run-off of the long-tail casualty classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year comparative column). The only explicitly quantified prior-year movement in the report is stated as a net (after reinsurance) release of GBP 22.8m; no gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure is provided, so the net figure has been used (flagged). No gross claims development triangle was found in the provided pages; RITC activity and reinsurance items in notes may distort development figures. Per-line reserve movements are not quantified in the report, other than commentary attributing improvement principally to favourable run-off in long-tail casualty classes.
